fields.statement: Take repetitive work off your desk with AI.
fields.subheading: Spend less of your week on reports, emails and slides. Learn the AI tools for office work in one hour a day, in Vadodara.

fields.heading: What changes at *work*
fields.intro: Three jobs most office roles share, before and after the course.

items.title: Weekly reports
items.before: Copying figures between sheets and writing the same summary again.
items.after: Upload the data, get charts and a first summary, then check and send.

items.title: Emails and documents
items.before: Every email and document starts from a blank page.
items.after: Copilot drafts in Word and Excel; you check and finish.

items.title: Meeting prep
items.before: Reading long documents the night before a meeting.
items.after: NotebookLM summarises them and answers your questions with sources.

fields.heading: How it fits around a *job*
fields.intro: One live hour a day, on the kind of work you already do.

steps.title: Choose your track

items.name: Nilesh Chaudasama
items.quote: Artificia helped me discover powerful AI tools that completely changed how I work. The training was practical, structured, and easy to apply in daily professional tasks.

items.name: Alphonsa N. P
items.role: Chief Nursing Administrator, Aadicura Super Speciality Hospital
items.quote: Joining Artificia was an eye-opening experience. The AI training is highly practical and directly applicable to modern healthcare operations.

items.question: Can I attend around office hours?
items.answer: Classes run one hour a day. Message us on WhatsApp for the current batch timings and pick the one that suits your day.

items.question: Is it useful if I mostly use Excel and email?
items.answer: Yes. The early days cover Copilot in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, research tools and data analysis, which is most office work.

items.question: Can I use AI on my company's data?
items.answer: With care. Day 6 covers AI ethics: hallucination, bias and what not to do. Always follow your company's own rules first.

items.question: Can my company train the whole team?
items.answer: Yes. We also run custom corporate programs, on-site or over Microsoft Teams. They start with a free 2-hour pilot.
